text: The purpose of this report is to recommend that Etobicoke York Community Council remove a director from the Corso Italia Business Improvement Area (BIA) Board of Management.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. In accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, removed the following directors from Business Improvement Area (BIA) Boards of Management set out below: Corso Italia: Deleo, Frank Lakeshore Village: Carol Ledden-Cusson
